second_reader._provenance: Transcribed from docs/GT_VAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md section 5. Second-reader agreement is a fact about the verification PROCESS, not about the shipped files, so unlike every other statistic in the table it cannot be recomputed from data/gt_test_1024/decisions/. It lives here as a committed artifact so that scripts/gt_verification_stats.py can read it and no number ever gets typed straight into the manuscript.
second_reader.method: Independent re-derivation from the drawing, reading the first pass's reasoning only afterwards.
